events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Russell (BKN) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes OOB.
Diabaté (CHA) and Russell (BKN) mutually engage off-ball and marginal contact occurs as Diabaté attempts to move Russell's left arm away.
Williams (BKN) initiates contact with Smith Jr.'s (CHA) right arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Diabaté (CHA) gathers the ball on both feet and takes two steps before his shot attempt.
Diabaté (CHA) clamps and holds Claxton's (BKN) left arm, which affects his ability to pursue the rebound.
Claxton (BKN) reaches for the loose ball and marginal arm to arm contact occurs with Bridges (CHA) as he secures the rebound.
Williams (BKN) is in the paint for at or about three seconds when he moves to imminently guard an opponent.
Claxton (BKN) cleanly blocks Salaun's (CHA) jump shot attempt.
Russell (BKN) remains in-bounds while making contact with the ball.
Thomas (BKN) gathers the ball on his left foot and takes two steps before his shot attempt.
The game is stopped due to a game clock malfunction. After correcting the clock, the game correctly resumes with Charlotte inbounding the ball.
Russell (BKN) releases the inbounds pass within 5 seconds.
Baugh (CHA) slides his arm across and off Thomas' (BKN) right side as they briefly engage off-ball during the inbounds play.
Bridges (CHA) cleanly blocks Thomas' (BKN) driving shot attempt.
Thomas (BKN) commits a take foul on Bridges (CHA).
Martin (BKN) commits a take foul on Smith Jr. (CHA).
Bridges (CHA) legally contests Watford's (BKN) jump shot attempt.
